standard_prerequisites: the equivalence of the probe and covering characterizations for the finite type property of formal algebraic spaces (lemma-finite-type of the same chapter)
the Formal Spaces local property criterion for finite type (formal-spaces-lemma-finite-type-local-property)
core_obligations: For a morphism f : X to Y of locally adic* formal algebraic spaces, the following are equivalent: (1) every etale affine probe pair gives an adic topologically finite type arrow of WAdm^adic*; (2) some cover of Y with covers of the base changes gives such arrows; (3) some cover of X factoring through etale maps toward affine Y_i gives such arrows; (4) f is locally of finite type.
The proof combines the probe-covering equivalence of the finite type lemma with the Formal Spaces local property criterion.
proof_roadmap: Identify condition (4) with the defining property via the Formal Spaces local property criterion.
Transport the probe/covering equivalence from the finite type lemma to the morphism level.
difficulty_reason: H2: a characterization ladder assembled from the arrow-level equivalence and the local property criterion.
